title: RPG Maker MZ games fail to launch on steam?

posts.author: Frankiesmileshow
posts.body:
Hello! I am the developer of Look Outside, and I've been trying to figure out a rare(?) but persistent issue with my game, that seems to be shared by other (maybe all?) rpg maker MZ games on steam - to some people, it refuses to run entirely on Steam. Some people it seems can't run RPG maker MZ games at all. It seems to me like it affects less than 1% of users, but it's hard to say.
One solution that has solved the issue for some of them, was to find the game.exe file and set it to run as administrator.
Some others found they could not run the game from steam, but could play it when they run the file directly. To some people, this worked and launched the game, but the game crashed shortly after. One person reported the game eventually worked after they reinstalled it and restarted their PC.
One person in particular found that they could not run ANY rpg maker MZ games at all. I asked them to try an older, non-steam build of Look Outside (the old Game Jam version of it, a much simpler game with no complex integrations) and it didnt work either - I asked them to try other random RPG Maker MZ games, and nope. None of them worked.
I started looking around in the Steam discussions for other RPG Maker MZ games, and sure enough, I've found many examples of player feedback reporting games failing to launch on steam in similar ways. It seems to me like most RPG Maker Games on steam who have a large enough fanbase ends up getting these reports. I have seen suggestions that an antivirus might be blocking the game from running.
Here are a few examples:

Similar reports from other games:
(I would like some help collecting reports like this)

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299900/discussions/2/4693405793413741961/
Felvidek (cant launch from steam, can from executable):
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299900/discussions/2/4338734531956236578/
Felvidek (no launch at all - they posted a debug printout, might be useful):
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299900/discussions/2/828204828240946524/
Castle Xenon (no launch - but dev found a fix? Player was using Windows 7?)
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3344820/discussions/0/603023301791481081/
Empire Chronicles (might be unrelated, dev replied steam was having general issues at the time):
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1623310/discussions/0/3976176932759460402/
Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga (Doesnt launch on steam, failed to initialize steamworks when running from file):
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1488200/discussions/0/4848777451367617383/
It seems there are some general issues with RPG Maker MZ games running on steam!
I suspect this is not one problem, but multiple problems that have some overlap.
I'm posting this here hoping others have more info or have encountered this issue. I would really like to find a pattern with these problems.
Potential answers so far:
-Antivirus problem
-Steam Integration problem (implementing Orange Greenworks etc is a bit janky, maybe there are common mistakes many people make? it would not surprise me if something was wrong with my steam integration setup.)
-Some sort of video card incompatibility affecting a small portion of users
-Some sort of resource conflict of some other kind - One person reported they could finally run Look Outside after a reinstall and rebooting their machine. I've seen at least one report of someone saying an RPG Maker game on steam could run fine only after they reinstalled windows(!).
Has anyone else had problems like this with their project? Has anyone found solutions? Has anyone noticed a pattern with these problems - like specific system, video cards, or maybe specific software installed that could be causing this?

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
From what I've seen:
1: Some video cards will try to force RPGMaker into another monitor, even if that monitor doesn't exist. This happens occasionally when the engine is launched. Not sure if that also holds with the deployed game, but if they see nothing at all on launch that could be worth investigating.
2: MZ has a minimum requirement of win8. The games will not work right on win7 or lower. I tested this on a deployed game and events misfired or didn't even show up right, but the minute I moved it back to win10 the exact same game (and deployment) ran fine.
3: Can't run from steam, can from exe: I've hit that with other games (not just RPGMaker games), and that usually means my steam has frozen up. Shutting down and restarting steam has fixed that one for me when it happens.
4: For the game works on a reboot issue. Win10 (and maybe 8? I never used 8 so no clue on that one) changed how shutdown works. If a user has always used that and
never
selected restart things in win10 start to get corrupted as all a shutdown then restart does is fast boot from your profile, which starts to get slowly corrupted with time.
That last one there is nothing you can do either, as that is user error. They should really be restarting the PC every so often anyways via the restart button in windows. And, even older engines have issues with that too. I hit an issue in ACE where the RGSSX player that engine uses got corrupted and the only fix was a restart via the restart button in windows.
Side note: Symphony of the night is not made in MZ.

posts.author: Frankiesmileshow
posts.body:
Someone on steam who is experiencing this issue with my game says they are willing to test other steam-integrated RPG Maker MZ games to see if they run properly.
The crash they are getting on runtime seems to trigger whenever a steam achievement-related command is run.
It definitely seems like the steam integration is the problem. Something must be wrong either with my Orange Greenworks setup, or with Orange Greenworks itself. Are there other popular steam integration plugins? If we could send this player another game that uses Orange Greenworks for the integration, we could maybe figure out if its a problem with the plugin itself, or if its something I'm doing wrong.
Update - adding a steam_appid.txt file to the games folder with the steam id inside seems to at least allow people to launch the game directly from the executable and prevents the in-game crashes afterwards, if the game fails to launch from the steam app itself.
Something doesnt work about the launching itself, its not that the game overall is broken for some players, its specifically the way steam launches the game that breaks. Once the game starts, as long as this file is present to tell the integration which steam app ID the game has (which is normally information given by the steam app on launch) then the game seems to work.
Still unsure what causes that failure to launch from steam, but at least this is a working measure that should allow some people to play if they just cant otherwise. I would recommend anyone who has this issue with a steam integration to include steam_appid.txt in their game files and ask those who cant run the game to run it directly from the exe.
